cached_post_nms: renms832 and cached-fusion inputs have already undergone confidence .001, view NMS .7 and max_det100. A later .5 NMS is two-stage postprocessing and is not equivalent to fresh detector NMS .5.
stable_order: Global NMS: descending confidence, then source/view order in plan, then original prediction index. Suppress same-class boxes only when IoU > threshold.
paired_score: Sort all source boxes by descending confidence, then source order and original index. Each unassigned box is a seed; match at most one unassigned box from the other model with the same class and IoU>=.55, using highest IoU then confidence then original index. Pairs never merge transitively. Coordinates are score-weighted; score=(s1+s2)/2, absent score=0. Drop scores<.001 after scoring, before final NMS and top100.
selection: Report the global winner using base-plan ranking. Recommend the highest-ranked candidate among those whose selected operating point improves BOTH precision and recall strictly over baseline; if none, retain baseline. Keep the global winner and eligible recommendation distinct when they differ.
deployment: Composite methods are experimental recipes, not ordinary roadguard-model-v1 manifests. They require exact-pipeline CPU and business-integration verification before activation. Existing workflow remains unchanged.
method_limitations: Parent/current models are related checkpoints, not independent model votes.
The same validation set is reused for selection; no new independent accuracy claim.
Low score truncation and max100 can remove useful boxes; no extra grid expansion this round.
